notes: AcquireCollaborationHistory uses current device/DIRECT/READY-room admission before and after the native window. The actual trace records 5/5/5 device/conversation/room reads, zero failures, and captures counters at context acquisition to require later admission too.
The proof no longer seeds the first history merge. The common use case must store both originals before verification/reopen/index checks. The later direct merge checks replay idempotence only.

One window has at most 128 combined original/unresolved entries, matches owner/device/room/anchor, and detaches mutable collections before suspension. Every 1-16-event batch is atomic; earlier acquired facts remain after a later conflict or uncertain response.

Known company/session denials survive failed persistence. Recipient-specific failure does not close company history. Final owner capture follows gate I/O. Only company-summary acquisition reopens the existing gate.
No history head discovery, provider cursor progress, implicit SDK restore/join/sync/queue delivery, sender-ACK inference or automatic retry was added. A known anchor is still required.
Unresolved entries include unsupported state events. The acquisition report is not an empty-history marker or a count of unreadable chat messages.
Android parses and hashes originals on Dispatchers.Default in the caller-owned structured operation. A held-dispatcher test cancels queued decoding and verifies native cleanup.

Extraction nanoseconds measure FFI copying/diagnostic extraction only, not JSON canonicalization, hashing, network or database latency; SDK diagnostic/cache allocation still precedes app bounds. This small fixture is not capacity acceptance.

Physical iPhone testing remains waived. No native Apple history execution is claimed. Prior ad0848e6 control CI is separately audited in the canonical history record (284 simulator cases, actual Xcode app-host build, 207 immutable source hashes).
Continue head discovery and bounded provider progress, ACK-before-journal reconciliation and retirement, then Chat UI and all call/meeting phases. Starter needs no generic port.
